parameters.name: accept
parameters.description: The format of the response returned by the specified server should be set to `application/json`.

mode.description: Video generation mode, optional, enumeration values: `std` (standard mode, 720p, lower consumption) or `pro` (professional mode, 1080p, higher image quality). The default value is `std`.

async.description: Whether to process in asynchronous mode. When set to `true`, the interface immediately returns `task_id`, without the need to provide `callback_url`, and then the result can be obtained by polling the corresponding task query interface; if `callback_url` is also provided, the result will be pushed to that callback address.

prompt.example: White ceramic coffee mug on glossy marble countertop with morning window light. Camera slowly rotates 360 degrees around the mug, pausing briefly at the handle.
prompt.description: Text prompts can contain both positive and negative descriptions simultaneously.

image_url.description: Reference image URL: The characters, background, and other elements in the generated video are all based on this reference image.

video_url.description: Reference video URL: The character movements in the generated video will be consistent with this reference video.

model_name.description: Model name, optional, enumeration values: `kling-v2-6` or `kling-v3`. If not provided, the server's default model will be used.

callback_url.description: Callback URL, after the video generation is complete, the system will send a callback notification to this URL.

watermark_info.description: Watermark configuration, optional. The object format is `{ "enabled": true }`. When `enabled` is set to `true`, results with watermarks are generated additionally, and custom watermarks are not supported at this time.

keep_original_sound.description: Whether to keep the original audio of the reference video, optional, enumeration values: `yes` (keep) or `no` (remove). The default value is `yes`.

character_orientation.description: Generate the orientation of characters in the video, which can be chosen to be consistent with the reference image (`image`) or reference video (`video`).
